name: Brave Stars Deck Building Gift Box

releases.name: Brave Stars Deck Building Gift Box

description.text: The Brave Stars Deck Building Gift Box (勇魅群星 卡组构筑礼盒) came out on 18 June 2024 for players who wanted to build their own deck from the new booster. It held one random Pokémon V holo, one of nine made in equal numbers: Serperior V, Charizard V, Origin Forme Palkia V, Zeraora V, Deoxys V, Kleavor V, Hisuian Samurott V, Origin Forme Dialga V and Arceus V. With it came 19 Trainer cards, key cards of the Sword & Shield game among them Brave Stars' Cynthia's Ambition and Choice Belt, a Double Turbo Energy, 48 basic Energy (six of each of eight types), a random 25-card Brave Stars pack, a player's guide and a deck box.
